record.title: Evaluate stock rollback and release or hold the RF comparison
record.intent: Resolve the first physical transition before relying on stock as an experimental arm.
requirements: Independently assess exact one-reboot delivery, new boot and stock mappings,17/17 witness, normal UI, logical preservation, fresh capture and thermal/deadline readiness. Success must not be inferred solely from connectivity.

On success supply evidence to the original execution decision for the already proposed stock-derived-stock comparison, with finalstock explicit. On failure leave the original gate open and record the exact failure; no automatic native reinstatement or repeated reboot is admitted.
Commit and push the conclusion before the next arm transition; preserve original protocol and specimen evidence and do not convert a completed preparation or rollback task into a positive RF result.

The original baseline stopped before any specimen command. Evaluate its preserved negative separately from the single successor baseline admitted after the host transport diagnostic; only independently verified successor stock evidence may release RF execution.

Preserve the successor local-directory negative separately. Only independently verified stock evidence from the baseline after complete evidence-layout preparation may release the RF comparison; neither predecessor negative is promoted into physical success.

The single rollback reached a new stock APK-backed epoch but stopped on an incorrectly four-byte time comparator. Reconcile pinned eight-byte timestamp semantics and separately verified read-only stock continuation; no additional initial-stock reboot or native transition is admitted. Treat the preserved partial transition and later warm17/17 witness as distinct linked evidence.
acceptance: A supported go or hold disposition reconciles the stock baseline with the original RF gate.

review.rationale: Reviewed the independently sealed partial single-reboot stock transition and pinned eight-byte timestamp writer/reader. The stopped four-byte comparator is corrected within the already recovered time-field allowance; fixed metadata, valid CRCs and all calibration payload/protected bytes remain required. A distinct read-only continuation must bind the same stock epoch, actual lease, accepted UI, serviced warmup and one16-byte stock witness. No new initial-stock transition/reboot is admitted; RF readiness remains conditional on independently verified continuation. This reconciliation records semantic dependency currency only.
